candidatesAccepted.summary: A long market street of food stalls where you can graze across Austrian, Turkish and Middle Eastern counters at your own pace. Ages and access needs were not answered and dietary needs were not mentioned, so I could not account for those; check stall menus before you go.

candidatesAccepted.title: Heuriger wine tavern evening in Vienna
candidatesAccepted.summary: A traditional wine-tavern meal with young local wine and simple regional dishes, a good low-effort way to sit down for a proper Viennese dinner. Ages and access needs were not answered, and I do not know your dietary needs, so please confirm menu suitability yourselves.

candidatesAccepted.title: Central Market lunch in Ljubljana
candidatesAccepted.summary: The covered market hall and arcades by the river, where you can eat seasonal local produce and cheese without committing to a full restaurant meal. Ages, access needs and dietary needs were not answered, so I could not account for them.

candidatesAccepted.title: Traditional buffet meal in Trieste
candidatesAccepted.summary: A classic Triestine buffet serving boiled meats with horseradish and sides, a distinctive regional meal worth a stop if you are in the city. Ages, access needs and dietary needs were not answered, so I could not account for them; the menu is heavily meat-based.

candidatesAccepted.title: Buy an eSIM or SIM at Vienna airport
candidatesAccepted.summary: Arriving with data on hand makes the first train transfers and offline check-ins easier across three countries. I could not check current provider prices or whether your phone is eSIM-compatible, and the trip's ages and access needs were not answered, so please confirm those before relying on this.

candidatesAccepted.title: Arrange trip insurance before leaving Halifax
candidatesAccepted.summary: Cover for medical care and cancellation matters more when every leg is a separate train booking. I did not check what any policy covers, and your ages and access needs were not answered, so pre-existing conditions and mobility needs are unknown to me and must be checked against the policy wording.
